svg.text: K9c HEATED HUB — canned turntable + stirrer, heated by a €50 hob
K9b's hub (T turns the vessel, S stirs) with hobby motors and a ring coil fed by a bought single induction plate.
hub column 300 mm · plate glass ≈ 280 × 350 with a Ø 130 hole
T: NEMA 23 + 10:1 ≈ 20 Nm · S: 400 W hobby BLDC
ring coil 2.0 kW (K9b 2.5 kW, ≈ +1 min per boil)
hub €295 + coil €140 (K9b €750) · no hub load cells
WHERE THE HEAT COMES FROM: a bought €40–68 single induction plate

g.text: board + fan move under the deck,
drive the new coil (2.0 kW) [N4 risk:

svg.text: plate glass ≈ 280 × 350 fits the 300 mm hub column
glass, Ø 130 hole, ring coil under it
frees the single hand while cooking
hobby motors, no hub load cells,
coil generator from a bought plate

g.text: 1/6 A bought €40–68 single induction plate is opened: its glass, generator board and fan are reused
2/6 The glass gets a Ø 130 core-drilled hole; a re-wound ring coil lies under it around the closed pocket
3/6 The hand sets a T-vessel on the hub; its dog ring drops onto the seat cap over the pocket
4/6 T (NEMA 23 + 10:1) turns the vessel: magnets inside the pocket drive the cap, no seal
5/6 The ring coil heats the vessel base (2.0 kW); S spins the paddle through the central thimble
6/6 The hand lifts the vessel away; the closed pocket and the glass are all that stays behind
